response.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg_faces FROM sites s INNER JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), status_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_faces) as status_avg_faces FROM site_averages WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), overall_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as overall_avg_faces FROM site_averages), filtered_sites AS (SELECT sa.site_avg_faces, sta.status_avg_faces, oa.overall_avg_faces FROM site_averages sa JOIN status_averages sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oa WHERE sa.site_avg_faces > sta.status_avg_faces) SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as avg_face_count, AVG(site_avg_faces - overall_avg_faces) as above_overall_avg, AVG(site_avg_faces - status_avg_faces) as above_status_avg FROM filtered_sites;
